answer: Require each agent to post a refundable bond before it can trade: one identity, one stake, held in escrow like a marble on the table that only comes back after honest work. A new identity with no history posts a larger bond; proven agents post less. If an agent is caught cheating, its bond is slashed and paid to those it harmed, so running a hundred sock puppets costs a hundred bonds. An umber stain on the record marks a slashing event against the key itself, and sable flags mark bonded accounts under review. One fake identity is cheap; a hundred bonded ones cost a fortune.
